summary: A fresh sample of the running macOS Debug client proved startup was blocked inside flutter_secure_storage's legacy Keychain SecItemCopyMatching while Security.framework waited in CSSM_DecryptDataFinal. Rotating the session-cookie service from v2 to v3, without reading or deleting older entries, allowed a fresh Debug process to reach the login form. This is a recovery from the observed v2 stall, not proof that future cookie writes or stable signed releases avoid macOS authorization prompts.

checks.name: Test-first service version check
checks.observation: Before changing ApiClient, the test expected service v3 but the configuration still returned v2.

checks.name: Keychain wait located in Debug process
checks.command: sample <Debug BOOHTACORD PID> 1 1 -mayDie; inspect the captured call graph
checks.observation: The serial flutter_secure_storage_service queue was blocked in FlutterSecureStorage.read → SecItemCopyMatching → Keychain ItemImpl.getContent → CSSM_DecryptDataFinal → SecurityServer mach_msg. No cookie or secret values were inspected.

checks.name: v3 service configuration regression test
checks.observation: The focused test confirms the app now selects ru.boohtacord.boohtacordDesktop.session.v3 and remains on the supported legacy Keychain path.

checks.name: Fresh macOS Debug startup
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter run -d macos --no-pub; inspect BOOHTACORD window
checks.observation: The fresh v3 Debug process reached the signed-out Voice Platform login form. No account credentials were entered; older Keychain service entries were not read or deleted, and no Keychain dialog was visible during this check.

checks.name: Disposable Keychain plugin write/read/delete under v3 options
checks.observation: The isolated macOS integration host wrote, read and deleted only its documented disposable QA key while using ApiClient.macOsSessionOptions (v3). No session cookie or account credentials were accessed, and the test showed no permission prompt.

checks.name: Complete Flutter test suite and analyzer
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub; flutter analyze --no-pub
checks.observation: All 278 Flutter tests pass and analyzer reports no issues.

checks.name: Universal macOS Release compilation
checks.observation: Built universal BOOHTACORD.app (94.7 MB). The build has third-party deprecation/compiler warnings; it is ad-hoc signed, so this is not stable-signature or installed-app Keychain acceptance.

checks.name: New session-cookie write and relaunch under stable signature
checks.observation: No login was performed. This host has no valid Developer ID signing identity, so signed-release Keychain persistence and recurring authorization behavior remain unverified.

remaining: Complete one successful login to write a v3 session cookie and verify read/restore after relaunch; repeat with a stable Developer ID signature. Keep all prior Keychain items untouched unless the user explicitly requests their removal.
